findings.contract: Retrying fulfillment must not duplicate external side effects.
findings.trigger_path: The mail provider times out after accepting a send; the loop sends again.
findings.impact: A customer receives duplicate confirmation emails and the paid state is committed independently.
evidence: The proposed code calls mailer.send on every retry and has no idempotency key or transaction boundary.
findings.fix: Use an idempotent delivery record/key and coordinate the state transition with durable retry processing.
findings.verification: Inject a timeout after provider acceptance and assert one delivery.
